blocks.summary: Choreographer behind Kylie's grand final show prepares to reveal final work. As Rafael Bonachela prepares to leave Sydney Dance Company, his final full season as artistic director looks to both its history and the next generation of dancers and choreographers. Veteran rugby prop cited for allegedly grabbing opponent's genitals. Veteran Ireland prop Leinster's Tadhg Furlong has been cited for allegedly grabbing the genitals of Munster's Gavin Coombes during their United Rugby Championship match last weekend.
